# BorderObject

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A border written as widths plus an optional colour. Omitted sides are **zero** ; an omitted `color` leaves the element's existing border colours alone.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`bottom`](#bottom): Bottom border width, in points.
- [`color`](#color): Border colour, applied to every side.
- [`left`](#left): Left border width, in points.
- [`right`](#right): Right border width, in points.
- [`top`](#top): Top border width, in points.
- [`width`](#width): Width applied to every side; the per-side values override it.
